name: office-outlook-mcp
description: Outlook / Microsoft 365 for Claude — read mail, folders, calendar, contacts and tasks, and send mail with confirmation

outlook_access_token.title: Outlook Access Token (optional)
outlook_access_token.description: A pre-obtained Outlook bearer token. Leave blank to capture one from your signed-in Outlook browser tab via the fetchproxy bridge.

tools.name: outlook_list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders with unread and total counts

tools.name: outlook_list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a folder, newest first

tools.name: outlook_get_message
tools.description: Get one message including its body

tools.name: outlook_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date window

tools.name: outlook_get_event
tools.description: Get one calendar event with attendees

tools.name: outlook_get_mailbox_settings
tools.description: Get time zone, working hours and auto-replies

tools.name: outlook_send_mail
tools.description: Send an email (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: outlook_create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft without sending (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: outlook_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a message read or unread (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: outlook_move_message
tools.description: Move a message to another folder (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: outlook_create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event (asks you to confirm first)

tools.name: outlook_healthcheck
tools.description: Report credential state and probe the API
